Role: Rande
Script:
- Setting: Forest (night)
- Music: Fast-paced music for a sense of urgency (strings)
- Charlene makes her entrance, scrambling in panic from one side of the stage to the other
Wilbert: Charlene, how could you be so selfish?!
- Wilbert storms onto the stage and grabs Charlene.
Wilbert: Come back with me! Count Lorenzo's still waiting for his bride!
Charlene: No!
- Charlene tries to break free, but Wilbert drags her away with him.
Wilbert: You have no right to refuse! I can't let my Jenna darling marry that old man in your stead!
Rande: Let her go!
- Wilbert pauses, and Charlene turns around.
- Rande enters, <style="highlight">angrily brushing Wilbert's hands away</style> and stepping in front of Charlene.
- Rande and Wilbert perform a duet: Wrong Path.
- Rande and Charlene slowly retreat as the duet continues.
Wilbert: Stop right there!
- Suddenly, Wilbert lunges forward to grab Charlene, but Rande <style="highlight">casts a spell to stop him</style>.
Rande: Charlene is not going back with you! She should not have to sacrifice her happiness for the sake of your greed!
Rande: Let's go, Charlene.
- Rande leads Charlene <style="highlight">offstage</style>. Wilbert struggles to his feet and glares resentfully at them.
Wilbert: Hmph... You two will pay for this!
- Wilbert exits, wounded.

扮演角色：兰利
剧本内容：
-舞台布景：暗夜森林
-音乐：节奏较快的弦乐，氛围紧张
-夏绿蒂登场，惊慌失措地从舞台一侧跑向另一侧
威尔伯：夏绿蒂！你这自私自利的孩子！你这毫无同情心的恶人！
-威尔伯登场，气势汹汹地抓住夏绿蒂
威尔伯：跟我回去！罗伦佐伯爵还在等他的新娘！
夏绿蒂：不！
-夏绿蒂挣扎，威尔伯要强行带她离开
威尔伯：你哪有说"不"的权利！难道要我可爱的小让娜替你出嫁？！
兰利：放开她！
-威尔伯的动作停止，夏绿蒂回头向后望
-兰利登场，<style="highlight">生气地拨开威尔伯的手</style>，将夏绿蒂护在身后
-兰利和威尔伯二重唱《歧途》
-歌唱过程中，兰利和夏绿蒂慢慢后退
威尔伯：站住！
-威尔伯突然向前冲，意图抓住夏绿蒂，兰利<style="highlight">施展魔法阻拦</style>
兰利：夏绿蒂不会跟你回去！没有任何人会为你的贪念而牺牲自己的幸福！
兰利：我们走。
-兰利拉着夏绿蒂<style="highlight">退场</style>，威尔伯艰难起身，愤恨地看着两人离去的背影
威尔伯：哼……你们会为此付出代价的！
-威尔伯负伤退场
